name: paravalence ~with my angel
source:
paravalence ~with my angel is a linear visual novel, a modern gothic story told across three interconnected stories. It involves distorted love, interdependent perspective, and western occultism.

The girl with the devil's braids...

19:00-03:00. After a decisive day on campus, Antoine meets Evangeline, another runaway, who teaches her about a new way of life. Inspiring and intuitive, especially on the part of the man in her dreams. I'll make use of this.

All out of love.

03:00-12:00. Wake up. I have precise instructions. If you can, Thomas, avoid all who prowl the night. This midday soap opera promises laughs and triumph.

My world, unwound at last.

12:00-19:00. Two idiot girls, Cecilie and Diana, think they can stop the end of the world. A futile feature for the last days.

[Edited from [url=https://effigysoftworks.itch.io/paravalence]itch.io[/url]]
